# Regression when built-in actions are removed

### What happened?
Normally, when a built-in action is removed from the editor's action set, its corresponding entry disappears from the menus. Removing only part of a related group of actions still behaves correctly.

Removing an entire group causes the regression. The screenshot below shows one menu in that state, and it is not the only menu affected, and not the only section of the menu that has the regressive behavior.

![bug_screenshot](/app/.harbor_assets/bug.png)

---
*Visual evidence is available in `/app/.harbor_assets/`. Open the screenshot(s) to understand the visual defect before writing your fix.*

arguments.prompt:
I'm investigating a bug in the tldraw repo. Context: In the editor's context menu / menus, when a built-in action is removed from the editor's action set, its menu entry normally disappears. But when an ENTIRE group of related actions is removed (e.g. all the "Copy as" or "Export as" submenu items), the submenu trigger still shows up (an empty or near-empty submenu). Some submenus like "Export as" also contain a non-action toggle item (e.g. "Transparent" toggle), so removing all the action items still leaves the submenu visible with just the toggle.

I need to understand how menus filter out empty groups/submenus. Please find and report:

1. The TldrawUiMenu components in `packages/tldraw/src/lib/ui/components/primitives/menus/` — specifically how `TldrawUiMenuSubmenu`, `TldrawUiMenuGroup`, and the context that tracks whether a menu/group/submenu has children. Look for something like a "useMenuIsOpen" or a context that counts children, and how empty submenus are hidden.

3. Any React context that tracks child count so a submenu knows if it's empty (search for things like "MenuContext", "child count", "hasChildren", useState registering children).

Report the exact file paths and relevant code snippets (with line numbers) for how submenus/groups decide whether to render when empty. Do NOT make any edits. Focus on identifying the mechanism and where it might fail when a whole group is removed.

I have a complete picture of the mechanism. Here is my report.

## Summary of findings

The core finding: **there is no child-counting or "is this submenu empty" mechanism at all** in the tldraw menu system. Submenu triggers and groups render unconditionally regardless of whether their children resolve to anything visible. Individual items self-hide, but the containers around them do not react to that.

### 1. The menu primitives (`packages/tldraw/src/lib/ui/components/primitives/menus/`)

**`TldrawUiMenuSubmenu.tsx`** — always renders the submenu trigger + content. It reads only the menu type/label from context and switches on `menuType`; it never inspects `children` to see if they're empty:
- Lines 45-95: for both `'menu'` and `'context-menu'`, it unconditionally returns the trigger button and a content container wrapping `{children}`. The only bail-out is `if (disabled) return null` at line 61 (context-menu only).
- Lines 104-112 `ContextMenuSubWithMenu` wires `useMenuIsOpen(id)` for open/close tracking — this is only open-state bookkeeping, not child presence.

**`TldrawUiMenuGroup.tsx`** — same story (lines 30-82): switches on `menu.type` and wraps `{children}` in a `div`/group container for every type. No check on whether children are null/empty.

**`TldrawUiMenuContext.tsx`** — the only menu context. It carries **just** `{ type, sourceId }` (lines 15-18). There is no child registration, no count, no `hasChildren`. `useMenuIsOpen` / `useGlobalMenuIsOpen` (`packages/editor/src/lib/hooks/useGlobalMenuIsOpen.ts`) only track open/closed menu IDs in the `tlmenus` global — again unrelated to child count.

I explicitly grepped `packages/tldraw/src/lib/ui` and `packages/editor/src/lib` for `Children.`, `childCount`, `hasChildren`, `registerChild`, `isEmpty` — nothing in the menu path counts children. `React.Children` is used only in `TldrawUiTooltip.tsx`.

### 2. How items check whether their action exists

`packages/tldraw/src/lib/ui/components/primitives/menus/TldrawUiMenuActionItem.tsx` lines 10-15:
```ts
const actions = useActions()
const action = actions[actionId]
if (!action) return null
return <TldrawUiMenuItem {...} />
```
Same pattern in `TldrawUiMenuActionCheckboxItem.tsx` (lines 17-20: `if (!action) return null`). Regular `TldrawUiMenuItem` also self-hides in some cases (e.g. readonly mode line 108, disabled context-menu items line 144).

So when an action is removed from the action set, the leaf item returns `null` — but that only removes the leaf. Its enclosing `TldrawUiMenuGroup` and `TldrawUiMenuSubmenu` still render.

### 3. Where it fails for a whole group / submenu

`packages/tldraw/src/lib/ui/components/menu-items.tsx`:

**`CopyAsMenuGroup`** (lines 240-263): renders `<TldrawUiMenuSubmenu id="copy-as">` containing a group of `TldrawUiMenuActionItem`s plus a second group `copy-as-bg` holding `<ToggleTransparentBgMenuItem />`. The submenu's only conditional is `disabled={!atLeastOneShapeOnPage}`. If every action (`copy-as-svg`, `copy-as-png`, `copy-as-json`) is removed from the action set, each item returns null, but the submenu trigger still renders.

**`ExportAsMenuGroup`** (inline in `ConversionsMenuGroup`, lines 304-312): `<TldrawUiMenuSubmenu id="export-as">` with `export-as-svg`/`export-as-png` action items plus an `export-as-bg` group containing `<ToggleTransparentBgMenuItem />`.

**`ToggleTransparentBgMenuItem`** (lines 160-175): this is the "Transparent" toggle. It renders `TldrawUiMenuActionCheckboxItem actionId="toggle-transparent"`. Critically, it is **not** an ordinary action item removal case — it is a checkbox toggle. Even if all the "real" export/copy action items are removed, this toggle keeps the submenu non-empty, matching exactly the bug described (submenu still shows with just the toggle). And if `toggle-transparent` itself is also removed, the submenu still renders an empty container because the submenu component never checks.

The DefaultContextMenuContent (`ContextMenu/DefaultContextMenuContent.tsx` lines 30-45) composes `<ConversionsMenuGroup />` etc. Note the design intent comment (lines 24-28): submenus are expected to "self-hide when they have nothing to offer" — but that self-hiding is implemented ad hoc per component (e.g. `EditMenuSubmenu` lines 344-347 checks selection count, `ConversionsMenuGroup` line 299 checks `atLeastOneShapeOnPage`). None of them checks whether their **action children** actually resolved to visible items.

### Root cause / where a fix would go

The mechanism that's missing: neither `TldrawUiMenuSubmenu` nor `TldrawUiMenuGroup` inspect whether their rendered children produce any visible output. Because `TldrawUiMenuActionItem` returns `null` when the action is absent, removing a whole group of actions leaves the submenu trigger (and any non-action items like the Transparent toggle) visible.

A fix would need one of:
- a child-registration/count context (a new provider in `TldrawUiMenuContext` where leaf items register, and the submenu/group renders null when count is 0), or
- having the submenu/group inspect resolved children (harder, since children like `ToggleTransparentBgMenuItem` are wrapper components, not raw items), or
- an "actions exist" guard analogous to the existing `if (!action) return null`, applied at the group/submenu level (e.g. `CopyAsMenuGroup` checking whether any of its action IDs exist before rendering the submenu).

Relevant files (all absolute):
- `/app/packages/tldraw/src/lib/ui/components/primitives/menus/TldrawUiMenuSubmenu.tsx`
- `/app/packages/tldraw/src/lib/ui/components/primitives/menus/TldrawUiMenuGroup.tsx`
- `/app/packages/tldraw/src/lib/ui/components/primitives/menus/TldrawUiMenuContext.tsx`
- `/app/packages/tldraw/src/lib/ui/components/primitives/menus/TldrawUiMenuActionItem.tsx`
- `/app/packages/tldraw/src/lib/ui/components/primitives/menus/TldrawUiMenuActionCheckboxItem.tsx`
- `/app/packages/tldraw/src/lib/ui/components/menu-items.tsx` (CopyAsMenuGroup ~240, ConversionsMenuGroup/ExportAs ~296-316, ToggleTransparentBgMenuItem ~160)
- `/app/packages/tldraw/src/lib/ui/components/ContextMenu/DefaultContextMenuContent.tsx`
- `/app/packages/editor/src/lib/hooks/useGlobalMenuIsOpen.ts` (open-state tracking only, not child count)
Now let me understand how submenu triggers get hidden when empty. The CSS `:empty` only hides the content popup, not the trigger button. Let me look for the child-counting mechanism.

import { useCanRedo, useCanUndo } from '../../hooks/menu-hooks'

import { KeyboardShortcutsMenuItem } from '../HelpMenu/DefaultHelpMenuContent'
import { InputModeMenu } from '../InputModeMenu'
import { LanguageMenu } from '../LanguageMenu'
import {
	ClipboardMenuGroup,

import { TldrawUiMenuGroup } from '../primitives/menus/TldrawUiMenuGroup'
import { TldrawUiMenuSubmenu } from '../primitives/menus/TldrawUiMenuSubmenu'

/** @public @react */
export function DefaultMainMenuContent() {
	return (
		<>
			<TldrawUiMenuGroup id="basic">
				<EditSubmenu />
				<ViewSubmenu />
				<ExportFileContentSubMenu />
				<ExtrasGroup />
			</TldrawUiMenuGroup>
			<PreferencesGroup />
		</>
	)
}

/** @public @react */
export function ExportFileContentSubMenu() {
	return (
		<TldrawUiMenuSubmenu id="export-all-as" label="context-menu.export-all-as" size="small">
			<TldrawUiMenuGroup id="export-all-as-group">
				<TldrawUiMenuActionItem actionId="export-all-as-svg" />
				<TldrawUiMenuActionItem actionId="export-all-as-png" />

			<TldrawUiMenuGroup id="export-all-as-bg">
				<ToggleTransparentBgMenuItem />
			</TldrawUiMenuGroup>
		</TldrawUiMenuSubmenu>
	)
}

export function EditSubmenu() {
	return (
		<TldrawUiMenuSubmenu id="edit" label="menu.edit">
			<UndoRedoGroup />
			<ClipboardMenuGroup />
			<ConversionsMenuGroup />
			<MiscMenuGroup />
			<LockGroup />
			<TldrawUiMenuGroup id="select-all">
				<SelectAllMenuItem />
			</TldrawUiMenuGroup>
		</TldrawUiMenuSubmenu>
	)
}

/** @public @react */
export function MiscMenuGroup() {
	return (
		<TldrawUiMenuGroup id="misc">
			<GroupMenuItem />
			<UngroupMenuItem />
			<EditLinkMenuItem />
			<ToggleAutoSizeMenuItem />
			<RemoveFrameMenuItem />
			<FitFrameToContentMenuItem />
			<ConvertToEmbedMenuItem />
			<ConvertToBookmarkMenuItem />
			<FlattenMenuItem />
		</TldrawUiMenuGroup>
	)
}

/** @public @react */
export function LockGroup() {
	return (
		<TldrawUiMenuGroup id="lock">
			<ToggleLockMenuItem />
			<UnlockAllMenuItem />
		</TldrawUiMenuGroup>
	)
}

/** @public @react */
export function UndoRedoGroup() {
	const canUndo = useCanUndo()
	const canRedo = useCanRedo()
	return (
		<TldrawUiMenuGroup id="undo-redo">
			<TldrawUiMenuActionItem actionId="undo" disabled={!canUndo} />
			<TldrawUiMenuActionItem actionId="redo" disabled={!canRedo} />

}

	return (
		<TldrawUiMenuSubmenu id="view" label="menu.view">
			<TldrawUiMenuGroup id="view-actions">
				<TldrawUiMenuActionItem actionId="zoom-in" />
				<TldrawUiMenuActionItem actionId="zoom-out" />
				<ZoomTo100MenuItem />
				<ZoomToFitMenuItem />
				<ZoomToSelectionMenuItem />
			</TldrawUiMenuGroup>
		</TldrawUiMenuSubmenu>
	)
}

/** @public @react */
export function ExtrasGroup() {
	return (
		<>
			<TldrawUiMenuActionItem actionId="insert-embed" />
			<TldrawUiMenuActionItem actionId="insert-media" />

				</TldrawUiMenuGroup>
			</TldrawUiMenuSubmenu>
			<LanguageMenu />
			<KeyboardShortcutsMenuItem />
		</TldrawUiMenuGroup>
	)
}

I now have a complete, precise understanding of the bug. Let me summarize before fixing:

**Root cause:** When an action item's action is removed from the action set, `TldrawUiMenuActionItem` returns `null` (self-hides). Empty groups/menu content are then hidden by CSS (`.tlui-menu__group:empty`, `.tlui-menu:empty`). This is why removing *part* of a group works.

But a **submenu trigger button** (`Copy as ›`, `Export as ›`) is a sibling of the (lazily-rendered, portaled) submenu content — no CSS `:empty` rule can reach it. The three export/copy submenus (`copy-as`, `export-as`, `export-all-as`) each pair a group of format-action items with a separate group holding the non-removable **"Transparent" background toggle**. So when all the format actions are removed, the toggle keeps the submenu non-empty and its trigger keeps showing — exactly the screenshot.

The fix: hide each of these submenus entirely when none of its format actions will render. Let me apply it to all three affected menus.

## Summary

I fixed a regression where removing an entire group of built-in actions left an empty submenu trigger behind in the editor's menus.

### Root cause

When a built-in action is removed from the action set, `TldrawUiMenuActionItem` self-hides (returns `null`), and empty groups/menus are then hidden by CSS (`.tlui-menu__group:empty`, `.tlui-menu:empty`). This is why removing *part* of a group works.

But the export/copy submenus (`Copy as ›`, `Export as ›`, and the main menu's `Export all as ›`) each pair a group of format-action items (`copy-as-svg`, `export-as-png`, etc.) with a **separate group holding the non-removable "Transparent" background toggle**. When all the format actions are removed, that toggle keeps the submenu non-empty, so the CSS `:empty` rule never fires — and a submenu *trigger* button is a sibling of the lazily-rendered, portaled submenu content anyway, so no `:empty` rule can reach it. The result: the `Export as ›` trigger lingers with only the "Transparent" toggle inside, exactly as shown in the screenshot.

### Fix

Gate each of the three affected submenus on whether any of its own format actions still exist, mirroring the existing `if (!action) return null` pattern used for individual items:

- `packages/tldraw/src/lib/ui/components/menu-items.tsx` — `CopyAsMenuGroup` (copy-as) and `ConversionsMenuGroup` (export-as)
- `packages/tldraw/src/lib/ui/components/MainMenu/DefaultMainMenuContent.tsx` — `ExportFileContentSubMenu` (export-all-as)

This covers both menus and both sections the report flagged ("not the only menu affected, and not the only section").

### Tests

Added regression tests in `packages/tldraw/src/test/ui/ContextMenu.test.tsx`: one asserting the submenus show by default, and two asserting each submenu disappears when its whole action group is removed via `overrides` while its sibling stays.

### Validation

- `yarn test run src/test/ui/ContextMenu.test.tsx` — 24 passed
- `yarn typecheck` — no errors
- `yarn lint-current` — clean (exit 0)

One note: the fix is scoped to the three known submenus that contain a non-action item shielding them from the CSS `:empty` behavior. A more general solution (a child-count context so *any* submenu self-hides when empty) would be a larger architectural change; I kept the fix targeted to the regression and the established codebase pattern. Let me know if you'd prefer the general approach.
